role: startup co-founder (positioning, objections, pricing, conversion path, truthfulness)
verdict: Positioning, pricing and the conversion path are best-in-class: one promise, a product-first hero, exact and honest prices, a signup sheet that carries the visitor's line and says plainly it is a design preview. The one thing holding it under 9.5 is the Try box itself, which answers an obviously hedged line with 'Nothing to cut' and leaves hype words in an announcement, so the core proof can miss on a visitor's first paste.
to_95: Make the Try box never look blind on a hedged line: when the on-device check leaves hedges ('I think', 'maybe', 'so you should', 'amazing', a trailing '!'), mark each with the dotted 'your call' underline already used for 'probably', make them tap-to-cut, and change the status from 'Nothing to cut' to 'Nothing cut · 3 your call'.
In the Studio signup sheet, carry the client maths the page already shows (4 clients: $72 a month, billed yearly) so the per-client price is not the only number at the moment of commitment.
At 390, add 'per client' to the Studio '$216 billed yearly' line.

issues.where: #sharpen Try box, 1440 and 390, pasted line: 'I think the Fed is probably going to cut rates in September, so you should maybe buy bonds'
issues.problem: Returns 'Nothing to cut' and the line unchanged. Only 'probably' gets a dotted mark and an explanation; 'I think', 'so you should' and 'maybe' are untouched, yet the page's own seeded example cuts 'so' and 'you should' from 'so basically you should sell into strength'. A trader pasting a hedged call, the core audience, sees the product find nothing in a line that is visibly soft. The recovery link ('Get a rewrite in your voice, free') is good but does not undo the first read.
issues.fix: Keep the engine conservative, but surface every hedge it recognises as a dotted 'your call' mark that is tap-to-cut (I think, maybe, so you should, probably). Status becomes 'Nothing cut · 3 your call'; why-line: 'These are your stance, so they stay unless you tap them.' Tapping updates the post card live. No fact changes, no auto-cut.

issues.where: #sharpen, pasted line: 'Excited to announce that we raised a $4M seed round led by an amazing group of investors!'
issues.problem: Output keeps 'an amazing group of investors!' while the Studio panel on the same page lists 'excited to announce' style hype as never-say. Founders, the third audience, will notice the leftover hype.
issues.fix: Give 'amazing/incredible/huge' and a trailing '!' the same dotted your-call mark as founder-1 so they are one tap away.

issues.where: Sheet opened from 'Start with Studio' (bento and pricing), 1440 and 390
issues.problem: Sub-line reads '$18 a month per client, billed yearly ($216 per client)' with no total. The page's best pricing line, '4 clients: $72 a month', is dropped at the commit moment, and an agency buyer thinks in totals.
issues.fix: Append the example the page already uses: '4 clients: $72 a month.' (or $96 on Monthly). No stepper needed.

issues.where: Pricing, Studio card at 390, collapsed state
issues.problem: Shows '$18 a month per client' then '$216 billed yearly' without 'per client'; reads as a $216 flat yearly total.
issues.fix: Change to '$216 a client, billed yearly'.

issues.problem: The rewrite add-on (+250 for $8, +750 for $22, +1,750 for $45) is only visible after 'See everything included', so a heavy user comparing 250 rewrites to their volume cannot see the ceiling is liftable.
issues.fix: Add four words to the visible Pro rewrites row: '250 rewrites in your voice a month · more from $8'.

issues.problem: Page is 8313 px tall at 360: 10.66 screens at a 780 px viewport, 10.39 at 800. It meets the 10.5 target only on the taller phone.
issues.fix: Trim about 120 px at 360, e.g. collapse the second neighbour post in the previews panel or tighten the voice panel's vertical gaps.
